payload.summary: Republish site_content: the live rows still carry the withheld lithium record's contaminated text
payload.detail: The lithium-physiological-withdrawal-tremor record's generated body (clinical hinge, sections, immediate actions, current presentation) was found to describe akathisia and drug-induced parkinsonism, and is withheld in the repo from 2026-09-16 (withholdGeneratedBody, applied in loadDifferentialSnapshot). The live site_content rows were seeded from the epoch-zero population frozen in supabase/migrations/20260824122000_add_site_content_release_and_outbox.sql and still hold the contaminated text, so it remains readable from the live database and reachable by retrieval. CI only CHECKS site content (build-site-content-manifest --check, check-site-content-freshness); nothing in CI or the Railway deploy republishes it. Closing this needs an operator run of scripts/sync-site-content-corpus.ts with --write, which requires --project-ref/--confirm-project-ref sjrfecxgysukkwxsowpy, --recovery-evidence, --provider-authorization and the expected state/plan/reconciliation digests. That is a governed live clinical database write and falls under the provider confirmation boundary, so it is the owner's to schedule. Do a --dry-run first and confirm the plan touches only this record.
